method: Native app accessibility state and actual settings menu interaction through cua_repl
observations: Hachiware, Chiikawa and Usagi each have separate visible, walking and recall controls.
Scrolling the actual settings window reveals Usagi camera, guitar, yellow staff and pudding controls with correctly named owner-specific seek buttons.
Usagi desk, furball and food controls and independent automatic-activity and click-voice switches are present.
The actual Usagi action menu lists study, eating, furball spit-up, camera, guitar and keepsake actions.
Selecting study changed Usagi's displayed status to studying and enabled its stop button, while the other characters retained their own item and action statuses.
The settings window was closed after inspection, leaving the native desktop companions running. No voice preview was played through the user's speakers and no preference toggles were changed.
found_and_fixed: Two old labels still described two friends. They were changed to a roster-independent label before the final package review.
limits: Attack hover geometry, extended weapon coverage and foreground window interception are covered by the packaged native regressions; no unsupported mouse-hover API was used in this UI pass.
